Carrione Marble Cabinet Knob

From the winding bed of Italy's Carrione River comes the coveted Carrara marble. Crafted by hand and balancing timeless beauty with clean contemporary style, this Carrara-inspired look takes new form in Amerock's Carrione collection.

Features and Specifications of the Carrione Collection Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Marble White/Golden Champagne
  • Material: Zinc
  • Length: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 1-9/16"
  • Base Dimensions: 9/16" L X 3/8" W
  • Screw Size: Includes #8-32 x 1in Truss Head Machine Screw

Special Order. NO RETURNS
